decision: The skill package (chatgpt_relationship-archive-reconstruction-v3.6/) is the engineering and data-integrity rulebook for this project. It is permanently read-only during application implementation. No file inside it may be created, modified, renamed or deleted as a side-effect of building the website.
rationale: The skill and the app are separate concerns. The skill is the specification; the app is the implementation. Changes to the skill, if ever needed, must be a separate, explicitly reviewed task — not a by-product of app work.
enforcement: Antigravity and all agents must treat chatgpt_relationship-archive-reconstruction-v3.6/ as read-only at all times.
If an app implementation decision appears to conflict with the skill, stop and report the conflict. Do not resolve it by editing the skill.
Any proposed skill change must be presented as a standalone reviewed task with an explicit diff before any file is touched.
This rule is recorded in AGENTS.md and PROJECT-STATUS.md so it survives session and model switches.
